description: This is a PHP class file (`ConfigDao`) in the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core module's Data Access Object layer. It manages configuration settings stored in the database, providing methods to set, get, and retrieve all configuration values.

classes.name: ConfigDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing configuration entities in the database. Provides methods to set, retrieve, and list configuration values.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the configuration value for a given key, creating a new Config entity if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value for a specified key; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Retrieves all configuration key-value pairs as an associative array.
